cards.card_text: Then the song turns to the people whose hearts are set on pilgrimage.
cards.verse_text: Blessed are those whose strength is in You, whose hearts are set on pilgrimage.
cards.snippet: …are those whose strength is in You, whose hearts are set on pilgrimage.

cards.card_text: The singer calls the people whose hearts are set on pilgrimage blessed.
cards.verse_text: Blessed are those whose strength is in You, whose hearts are set on pilgrimage.
cards.snippet: …are those whose strength is in You, whose hearts are set on pilgrimage.

cards.card_text: Next he talks about God's statutes and what they are to him "in the house of my pilgrimage."
cards.verse_text: Your statutes are songs to me in the house of my pilgrimage.
cards.snippet: Your statutes are songs to me in the house of my pilgrimage.

cards.card_text: On his pilgrimage, the psalmist says God's statutes are ___ to him.
cards.verse_text: Your statutes are songs to me in the house of my pilgrimage.
cards.snippet: Your statutes are songs to me in the house of my pilgrimage.
